scope: Observed normal Android gameplay on one emulator with diagnostic observer hooks disabled. This is a concise outcome summary; private logs and saved-profile evidence are not part of this source repository.

rewarded_ad.qualification: An actual native earned reward reduced the natural nursery deadline. This observation does not establish every ad creative, unearned-close branch or production ad-fill behavior.

android_back: Android Back closed the Daily and ordinary outing-result modals and navigated Safari to Home without exiting the app process.

final_banked_outcome.qualification: Aggregate observed outcome only, not a saved-profile dump or a promise of starting balance.

screenshots.qualification: All packaged captures have the stated framebuffer dimensions. Logical tablet overrides do not establish physical-tablet testing. No fabricated gameplay state or decorative framing is claimed.

limits: One emulator; physical devices and tablets remain unverified.
Emulator audio output was disabled; audible Android sound remains unverified.
Interactive browser, browser audio and WebGL behavior remain unverified.
Official Google test ads only. Production AdMob and Play Games IDs, account/backend configuration and consent verification remain owner work.
The observed earned reward does not establish an unearned early-dismiss branch, broad ad-fill reliability, every ad creative or every gameplay path.
Human balance/content acceptance, multi-day progression and store publication were not established.
The Godot 4.5.1 test export uses minimum API24 and target API35. Current store release eligibility requires owner verification.
Hosted CI outcome is separate from local native verification. Live Pages deployment remains held.

interstitial.qualification: Actual native between-round presentation observed; this is distinct from production ad-fill reliability.
